integrity: Proof of the full parameter theorem is analytic; supplemental finite rational checks are not substituted for it. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-dimensional affine real arithmetic and a single independent unbiased integer rounding per update; multiplier in [-1/2,1), target in (0,1). The sharp factor is a supremum, not attained. No extension to higher dimensions or arbitrary arithmetic is asserted.
title: Sharp three-state threshold and threefold noise inflation for stochastic rounding of scalar contractions
